Century Radiance Generation II S00 uses the following direct development or peer dependencies.

| Component | Version | Role | License |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Three.js | 0.186.1 | Peer authority for rasterization and base PBR, Playground development dependency | MIT |
| TypeScript | 5.9.3 | Compiler and type checker | Apache-2.0 |
| Vite | 6.4.6 | Playground and browser QA build tool | MIT |
| `@types/node` | 24.19.1 | Node type declarations | MIT |

The reproducible dependency graph is recorded in `package-lock.json`. Installed packages retain their own license and notice files. Unreal Engine 4.1 and Century Radiance Generation I were read-only architectural references and are not included or linked as dependencies.
